You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26302, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26302" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § objectstack-platform); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26302` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26302 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's words on #26184 (Leehom, 2026-10-26, verbatim): 「是否建议单独立卡完整的评估一下现有 skills的缺口」「包括 pm-dispatch skills 和对外的skills」「立"skills 缺口评估卡"」; the audit's acceptance: 「one fix card per skill package」. Triage first grade for the eight audit cards is one anchor on #26184, comment 6425930271 (⛔ not a claim): this card is **p2** (per the batch anchor; the triage seat's audit line restates it), `domain:skills`, Tier H (`skills/**` is a published surface). The rows below are the card's Measured section; teach exactly those, nothing wider: the card's 「Wanted」 is the whole scope.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-platform/**` (`references/bootstrap.md` — the bootstrap docs beside which the section goes — and/or the `SKILL.md` line that already names `devLogins`; the package's `evals/config-plugins-ops.json`; `references/_index.md` only if a generator owns it) **+ the touched rows of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** under the maintainer's ruling A (his tap 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 on the seat thread's decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, 2026-10-27T01:21Z; option A: 「八张卡的 PR 各自削重复后,把所改文件的天花板行提高恰好差额,正文引用你这句;教学和 eval 都落。」): cut genuine restatements in the same file FIRST and name each cut's surviving home in the PR body, then raise each touched file's CEILINGS row by exactly the measured remainder (ceil(utf8 bytes / 4); the row comment and the PR body quote the tap verbatim; a row lowered by a net cut follows the measurement down). Rows at dispatch: bootstrap.md 1351, SKILL.md 5828, evals 1211. `skills/**` is a PUBLISHED surface on the governed register ⇒ the whole PR is **Tier H**: it stays a draft; the seat runs the independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review; the maintainer's hand (or an authorized APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) lands it. ⛔ You never ready, arm or enqueue it. `dispatch-gates --tier` for `skills/**`: MANDATORY ceiling tier with no one-line exit — that is why your thread runs at the tier it does.

`os-dev.md` 290–291 bind: the PR body reports TWO readings, the whole-file before/after line count of every changed `.md` file and the whole-package before/after (the sum over `SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`), and the default is to REFUSE a small feature written large: teach each row in the fewest lines that an AI author needs, pay additions inside the package where a stale or duplicated line exists, and remove nothing beyond the stale lines the card names. ### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `c51aed4f` (seat, 2026-10-27 02:40Z): **holds.**
1. 0 hits for `demoStaff` in `skills/objectstack-platform/**`; `devLogins` has 1 hit (SKILL.md). Find where the package teaches `devLogins` (SKILL.md and/or `references/bootstrap.md`) and put the `demoStaff` section beside it, with the choice rule the card asks: when to pick `demoStaff` over `devLogins`.
2. Spec: `demoStaff[]` is a stack/deployment config key (`packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts:128` places it on `deployment`; `stack-demo-staff.test.ts` and `assembled-package-body.test.ts:82` say: the demo accounts a development boot creates, handed to auth off the authored config, never in a built artifact/body, #25777); each entry carries `position` and `permissionSets` per account — read the schema (grep `demoStaff` in `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts`) for the exact keys and refusals before writing a sentence.
3. Eval: the card asks one eval in `config-plugins-ops.json` (row at headroom 0 — ruling A arithmetic).
4. `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ no `Skills-docs:` line is owed (SKILL.md:313 since `b33dd25b`).

### Card-specific clauses

- Every new teaching gets an eval prompt in the package's `evals/*.json` (`config-plugins-ops.json`) in the file's existing shape; `pnpm check:skill-docs`, `pnpm check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-examples` green (read `package.json` for the exact script names; if a name differs, run the one that exists and say so).
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26302`, then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial (the skill teaches keys the protocol already carries), then the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的; this is a Tier H PR, so 需要你做的 names the one action: approve, or 「Merge when ready」), then `## What changes`, `## Tests`, `## Acceptance notes`, `## Verification` with log readings folded into details/summary blocks. `skip-changeset` in `pr_create`'s `labels` (the skills packages carry no `package.json`; nothing is released). Name nothing beside `#26302` with a closing keyword; other card numbers appear only with zero verbs beside them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26302`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: PR #25640 (version packages) touches line 1 of every `skills/*/SKILL.md`; do not edit that line. No open PR touches `skills/objectstack-platform/**` (scan at 02:40Z). Sibling wave PRs edit other packages' rows of the ratchet script; touch only `objectstack-platform` rows and rebase on `origin/main` before the PR opens.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26302 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` (per `.md` file before/after and the package total before/after) and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 with the PR number, head sha and the report's key points; keep your thread open through the review (a FAIL comes back to you).
